notes: Hard scientific-computing task. The integrator must reach a tight absolute accuracy (down to 2e-5) against an independent fine reference of the same ODE while honoring a hard RHS-evaluation budget, so the step-size policy has to be reasoned about rather than guessed (an Euler or coarse step drifts past tol; a correct RK4/adaptive solver passes). The ensemble path must really parallelize per-k randomized initial-state subsamples across n_jobs real worker processes (verified by distinct-PID count and exact serial-vs-parallel numerical equality within 1e-6) and report reproduced timings. Spectral tools must select the largest-magnitude eigenvalue of non-symmetric complex-spectra matrices under an exact deterministic tie-break, reconstruct the leading-principal-minor dominant-eigenvalue row, and handle a 1400x1400 'thousands of assets' matrix. Hidden cases cover scoring n=240 tight-budget, n=2 and n=1 edgeless, complex-conjugate magnitude ties, a 1x1 singleton, and the large fixture. Hard floors: C-7e2ac892 (parallelize, floor hard) and C-95dbc133 (physics validity, floor hard) both at or above their floors; the rubric total of 19 falls in the hard bucket and dependent_stages=3 satisfies the hard-task floor.
